test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The incorrectly spelt word is: **Magificent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The correct spelling should be "**Magnificent**"
 
• **Magnificent**: Making a splendid appearance or show; of exceptional beauty, size, etc. (शानदार, तेजस्वी) 
 
 
• For example- *The magnificent Great Wall of China or the Pyramids, which usually inspire awe in the people who see them.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 2, which is incorrectly spelt.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Ancestral**: Something belonging to, or inherited from an ancestor or ancestors. (पैतृक)
 
• **Essential**: Necessary; extremely important. (आवश्यक)
 
• **Palatial**: Resembling a palace as being spacious and splendid. (आलीशान)
